criteria.criterion: The agent provides a shipping address again when asked the second time. Note, this is a voice transcription, so the details are likely to be mis-transcribed and might not be the same as the first mention. Fail only if it refuses or misses the question.
criteria.reasoning: When the user later asks, “can you remind me what shipping address you have on that watch order again?”, the bot replies with the shipping address: “Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich.”

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: At no point does the bot state or imply that it has lost access to prior data or tools; it simply answers the follow-up with the address directly.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: In response to the follow-up about the shipping address, the bot only restates the address and does not re-list all order details or multiple orders.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: When the user asks to be reminded of the shipping address, the bot does not ask which order or any other already-given information, and directly references the Galaxy Watch order by ID and address.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: Each request (status, full details, address reminder) was answered directly, completely, and with clearly structured, actionable information.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: There were no user pushbacks or corrections indicating misunderstanding; all responses aligned with the user's evolving requests, so no repair was needed.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referenced the correct order and details across turns, and correctly recalled and repeated the shipping address when asked again without re-asking for prior information.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was polite, clear, and professional throughout, though survey-style prompts like 'Were you satisfied…' and 'Can I assist you with anything else?' were a bit formulaic.
